Chapter 95 Support (For Subscription)

As the emperor of the Great Yu Empire, the master of millions of subjects, and the commander of an army of 400,000, Zhong Yu has too many things to deal with.

Therefore, although he was more concerned about the battle situation of the Southwest Route Army led by Sun Jian, he did not devote too much energy to always pay attention.

Just a little understanding of the general situation of the battle, how the outcome of the enemy and the enemy will be, and how the commander of the Southwest Army will make a general understanding, so I won't pay more attention.

Because at this moment, he still has more important matters that he needs to handle and supervise personally, such as the Northwest Theater that he has come to now.

As the military and political center of the entire Edel Union, the essence and capital of the entire alliance are placed here. It can be said to represent the symbol of the entire Edel Union, and its importance is self-evident.

Therefore, the offensive of the two armies in the northwest has just begun, but they wiped out the barbarians in the southeast and northwest where Zhong Yu's forces are located, and captured tens of thousands of his population.

It was discovered by the tribes in the northwest region who had exercised a high degree of vigilance because of perennial wars, always competing with the other two major forces, almost every year without fighting.

There are so many tribes with news of someone invading, because of the long-term war, they have to unite with the surrounding tribes in order to survive, thus forming a very high degree of tacit understanding and trust.

Immediately communicated with each other and concentrated their forces to the front line. Under the leadership of the Nuoer tribe, a large tribe in the south, they organized a defense line to resist the enemy's attack. This set of actions is very crisp and neat, compared with the other two areas. I don't know how many there are!

At the same time, a messenger was sent to report to the lord, asking the lord to send a large army to repel and eliminate this rebel army, and then when Liu Bei, the commander of the two armies, led their 50,000 troops to the northwest region.

Suddenly, it was discovered that the front line of this area had already stationed in the entire south of the northwest area, most of the troops were stationed there with nearly 10,000 people, and a relatively complete set of defensive positions had been built.

The checkpoints are set up in dangerous places, and they are guarded according to the dangers. They are stuck in places where the army must pass through if they want to enter the northwest region. The location is not bad. If the army wants to attack the northwest region, it must face these checkpoints.

Otherwise, you have to always bear the threat of those enemies behind you, and your food road and retreat can be cut off by them at any time, which is unbearable for any large army.

Therefore, Liu Bei and Yu Jin discovered very painfully that if they wanted to win the entire northwest region, no, even entering the northwest region, they had to follow the battlefield planned by these tribes.

Use your own soldiers to push forward with upright battles, and use the lives of countless soldiers to open this passage. Therefore, when the two found that it was impossible, they directly joined the two armies and led the soldiers with absolute superiority. Overwhelmed.

In the first few days, when the news of their attack had just reached Edel City, the leader of the Eder Alliance, and they were still gathering a large army, when it was too late to support, Liu Bei and the two directly used their own superior forces to attack this line of defense.

I want to see if I can open this line of defense when their strength is only 1/10 of their own, and only a mere ten thousand people. Gain greater advantages for your future Northwest strategy and take the strategic initiative.

As a result, after three days of fighting, the two had to find out sadly that the fighting experience of these tribes was completely incomparable with those of the small tribes in the south!

Everyone in the tribal alliance seems to have experienced several years of war, and has incomparably skilled combat experience in how to deal with the enemy's offense and defense.

In the face of various special situations, they can also come up with solutions and responses without fear. When the two of them tried all their strategies, they couldn't find any big gaps that could allow them to gain a decisive advantage.

They can only use some surprise attacks to make some insignificant gains, and it will be difficult to achieve greater results after killing hundreds of them, and the battlefield situation remains stalemate like this.

Until three days later, although Liu Bei and his two men did not count losses, they attacked fiercely day and night, consuming countless strategic materials and losing countless soldiers.

Bows, crossbows and sharp arrows, which are often distressed for more than a few times, and expensive catapult ladders, will be launched at high intensity regardless of loss, and countless scraps are scrapped.

In normal times, the elite soldiers, who would be distressed if they were killed or injured, were also rushed to the battlefield batch after batch, and were used to fill the cannon fodder queues for the siege meaninglessly.

In just three days, the two people who originally had 20,000 crossbow troops were directly reduced to only 10,000. The remaining 10,000 people were scrapped because their crossbows were overused and couldn't bear it, and they retreated helplessly. Accept supplies.

And there are only 30 of the original hundreds of catapults left, and most of the ladders have been broken. Although the result is a pity, most of the opposite city has been destroyed, and it only takes a day or two to get it. Down.

But at this moment, the lord of the Edel tribe behind them also rushed over with 20,000 reinforcements, and the defenders, who had been reduced to only 3,000 because of their own fierce attack, suddenly became more powerful. .

But because of the three-day attack on his own side, he lost 30,000 troops, and another 20,000 people retreated to the rear due to serious injuries, unable to participate in the next attack.

More than half of the military supplies were lost, and a large number of powerful equipment could only be replenished by waiting for resources from the rear. Morale was low and military supplies were in short supply, and the army was unable to launch a strong attack anymore.

We can only camp with a large army, carefully guard against the barbarian attacks on the opposite side, and at the same time send messengers and ask for help from the rear, waiting for the reinforcements that His Majesty said before he set off, if he encounters major setbacks and it is difficult to march, he can ask him for help.

Sure enough, after Zhong Yu heard the battle between these two men, he already understood that Liu Bei had banned 100,000 of them, and it was impossible to win the most elite northwest region of the Edel Alliance. He had to have a steady stream of military supplies behind him. support!

Therefore, he decisively decided to lead the remaining 150,000 cannon fodder and drive to the northwest region together. He was going to meet his so-called leader of the alliance for a while, and how powerful the most elite force in the legend of the entire alliance was.

He understands that this battle is not as idle as the forces in the north and southwest. They are constantly fighting with each other. It can be said that each tribe is full of contradictions and it is difficult to get together. That's why so many jobs surrender.

And because of the year-round battles with the other two major forces in the Northwest region, in order to survive, they have put aside all grievances and united with each other, and because of the year-round battles, they have cooperated in an incomparable tacit understanding.

At the same time, because the tribes there are considered large tribes, there are no less than a thousand people, and the main gods enshrined by those tribes are also more powerful. If you don't hesitate to sacrifice your entire body as a sacrifice, in exchange for a moment of strength.

Under the gift of the power of those clan gods, the leaders of those tribes with thousands of people can almost all display their third-level strength, which is the power that only the leaders of large tribes with 5,000 people can have.

And the leaders of those big tribes with 5,000 people can temporarily break through the third level, reaching a power between the third level and the fourth level. Without him, thousands of people go to besiege and kill, it is almost impossible to win.

As for the large tribes with more than 10,000 people, the gods they enshrine basically possess the existence of divinity, and they can be called demigods. That kind of title can directly show that they are fundamentally different from mortals. It is almost not an existence that can be settled by a large number of people.

And the 300,000 luck points left by Zhong Yu are used to deal with this kind of unconventional existence. Without so much luck reserves, he really dare not just wreak havoc in the Edel Alliance with such a big fanfare!
